gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-tamil: Ancient and powerful, Nordic spaces its closed, monoweight letters like brush dabs far apart. Anek Tamil, a modern sans-serif of big round lowercase bowls, lets Nordic work best large and in few words.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-telugu: Powerful in feel, Nordic draws one thick thread through every letter, each opening pinched shut. But Anek Telugu keeps its wide, tall bowls unlatched and clean, while Nordic would clot up if made small.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anuphan: Clean-edged and ruler-drawn, Nordic holds a constant line width with letters spaced far apart. And Anuphan, a sans-serif of big round bowls and open curves, gives that tight-lipped heading something to breathe against.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-arimo: Tight, weighty, a little ancient: Nordic closes its letters up and spaces them like far-apart brush dabs. Yet Arimo, a sans with a tall mean line and open terminals, would read steadily down a whole column of text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-armata: Nordic is at its best loud and ancient, a constant-pressure line with cramped openings. Armata earns its place by staying open, with generous gaps between characters and lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-athiti: Athiti is a contemporary sans-serif that looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width. And across paragraphs it stays approachable, its see-through s letting light in where Nordic keeps its openings shut.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads in a friendly, plain-spoken way, with wide-set terminals on s and capitals that feel clipped next to the lowercase. Nordic's closed, powerful letters supply the weight up top.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads friendly and current, its lowercase eyes as big as washers and its rounds left unlatched. And line after line should go down smoothly, leaving Nordic to keep its closed, ancient look.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clean and approachable, with a large clear eye on every e and small counters that never clog. Nordic takes the loud, ancient work; Biryani takes the fine detail.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-blinker: Weighty and sealed-up, Nordic sets its brush-dab letters far apart with every opening closed. Blinker holds its line thickness steady and its apertures open, leaving Nordic to earn its keep big and brief.
